title: feat(mesh): MESH-MAT-001 fixture-only material evidence + orthotropic research sidecars
intent: Implement the amended MESH-MAT-001 rulings against current main: ToolBox-local MaterialEvidenceBundle under app.mesh.materials, ADR-0012 epistemic vocabulary, explicit OrthotropicPlate construction (no from_wood default, no inverse_solver), and research-only prediction/residual sidecars. Do not restore deleted fields/retopo scaffold; do not mutate qa_core or cam_policy; do not accept caller HARDWARE=true.
behavior_change: Adds a new research-only material evidence → orthotropic state → Rayleigh–Ritz prediction → residual comparison surface under services/api/app/mesh/materials/. New JSON contracts material_evidence, material_prediction, and prediction_residual are registered. No manufacturing-policy or qa_core behavior changes. Missing E_C fails closed. Assumptions (G_LC, Poisson) serialize as ModelAssumption metadata, not as EpistemicStatus.

diff_articulation.what_changed: (1) New app.mesh.materials package: evidence importer with ADR-0012 EpistemicStatus, HARDWARE=true rejection, SI canonicalization; OrthotropicMaterialState.from_evidence with ModelAssumption serialization and fail-closed missing E_C; predict_plate_modes wrapping solve_rayleigh_ritz with epistemic_status=predicted and research_only=true; compare_modal_prediction residual sidecar. (2) Contracts + schema_registry entries for material_evidence, material_prediction, prediction_residual. (3) Fixture-only spruce evidence + incomplete E_C fixture. (4) 19 unit tests covering import rules, orthotropic assumptions, prediction, residuals, schema validation, and package boundaries (no from_wood, no inverse_solver import, not under app.materials, no qa_core/cam_policy touch). (5) Handoff documenting amended Q1–Q7 rulings. REVIEW HARDENING: (a) evidence.py rejects research_only=false (was silently accepted on a surface defined as research-only) and rejects duplicate properties, including the canonicalization collision where E_L and E_L_Pa both normalize onto E_L_Pa and MaterialEvidenceBundle.get() would silently keep the first; values must be a JSON array, not any Sequence (str qualified). (b) orthotropic.py makes nu_cl Optional and omits it from to_dict() when E_C is absent, instead of publishing a placeholder 0.0 that reads as a known measurement of zero; caller-supplied g_lc_pa/nu_lc/nu_cl overrides are now recorded as ModelAssumption instead of silently bypassing evidence. (c) predictor.py validates positive integer mode counts and documents that boundary_condition applies to both axes. (d) residuals.py matches mode_indices in a first pass across ALL predictions before any frequency fallback (previously an earlier prediction's nearest-frequency guess could consume a measurement that a later prediction named explicitly, making pairing depend on prediction order), emits match_basis so a consumer can tell a labelled pairing from a proximity guess, rejects negative tolerance_hz, validates measured frequencies and mode_indices shape, and the docstring now describes the algorithm actually implemented. (e) material_evidence.schema.json encodes the observed/derived provenance requirement as an if/then so schema-valid payloads cannot fail at import, and pins research_only to const true; prediction/residual schemas are additionalProperties:false at the top level and declare match_basis. All three hashes regenerated. (f) import_material_evidence and compare_modal_prediction were decomposed to clear the complexity ratchet, which this PR was failing at 16 and 21 against a threshold of 15.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: app.materials is the curated tonewood registry; this is specimen-specific research evidence. Mesh Pipeline v0.1.0 fields/retopo were deliberately removed and are not restored. DO-103 Stage 3 HARDWARE provenance is deferred behind an adapter seam.

files.intent: Memoize Gauss-Legendre quadrature nodes behind gauss_legendre().
files.behavior_change: leggauss(n_quad) was called four times per solve with identical arguments (twice each in stiffness and mass assembly); it is now computed once per n_quad and cached. Numerically identical - 43 plate/rayleigh tests unchanged. The cache also pins the computation to the first call in a process, which is what makes the conftest warm-up able to avoid the api-verify _NoValueType failure.
